# Armories and Pods
## Gamma Armory
[bold]Called by: Any two of:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], or [color=#2253b5]NanoTrasen Representative[/color] [bold]OR any three[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] members.
[bold]Arrival time:[/bold] 1 minute.
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] Code Gamma is active. Standard armament is insufficient for security to respond to the active threat. The armory provides additional lethal equipment for security personnel.
Must not be called during a War Declaration.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Recalled when:[/bold] The armory is no longer needed, or its position is blocking the evacuation shuttle dock. Two minutes must elapse before recall is available.
[bold]Recalled by:[/bold] Any [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] member.
## Psi Armory
[bold]Called by: Any two of:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], [color=#cd7ccd]Research Director[/color], or [color=#2253b5]NanoTrasen Representative[/color] [bold]OR any three[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] members.
[bold]Arrival time:[/bold] 1 minute.
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] Code Psi is active. Standard armament is insufficient for security to respond to the active hostile silicon threat.
Must not be called during a War Declaration.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Recalled when:[/bold] The armory is no longer needed, or its position is blocking the evacuation shuttle dock. Two minutes must elapse before recall is available.
[bold]Recalled by:[/bold] Any [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] member.
## Emergency Medical Pod
[bold]Called by: Any two of:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#57b8f0]Chief Medical Officer[/color], or [color=#2253b5]NanoTrasen Representative[/color] [bold]OR any three[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] members.
[bold]Arrival time:[/bold] 2 minutes.
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] Medical is damaged and can no longer treat crew, or is overwhelmed and needs more room to treat crew.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Recalled when:[/bold] The medical emergency has passed and the pod is no longer needed, or its position is blocking the evacuation shuttle dock. Two minutes must elapse before recall is available.
[bold]Recalled by:[/bold] Any [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] member.
## Unlock Escape Pods
[bold]Called by: Any two of:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], or [color=#2253b5]NanoTrasen Representative[/color] [bold]OR any three[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] members.
[bold]Unlocks in:[/bold] 90 seconds.
[bold]Conditions:[/bold]
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
